description: Paid: US$0.005 per call in USDC over x402 (or 5 prepaid credits), with no monthly quota. Fetch one retailer product page now and return whether it still exists, its current price and stock. Not charged if the page could not be read. Without payment the result is an x402 payment request; attach the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"] and call again. check_product_link does the same within the free monthly allowance.

url.description: Product page url on a retailer exNiche covers, e.g. the url of a search result.
